Description: Customers can initiate and submit insurance claims by entering incident information and saving incomplete claims.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description: Customers can upload, view, remove and validate supporting documents.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description: Customers can track claim status, view status history and identify pending actions.

Creator: Divyasree T

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to start a new insurance claim so that I can report an incident.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Customer must be logged in.
* New Claim option must be available.
* Claim registration form must open.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to enter incident details so that the insurer understands my claim.
*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Customer can enter incident date.
* Customer can select incident type.
* Customer can enter incident location and description.
* Mandatory fields must be validated.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to submit my claim so that the insurer can begin processing it.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* All mandatory information must be valid.
* Claim must be saved successfully.
* Unique claim reference number must be generated.
* Submission confirmation must be displayed.

Summary: Save an Incomplete Claim as a Draft
Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to save my incomplete claim as a draft so that I can complete it later.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Customer can save incomplete claim details.
* Confirmation must be displayed.
* Customer can reopen and continue the saved draft.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to upload supporting documents so that I can provide evidence for my claim.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Customer can select supporting files.
* Uploaded documents must be associated with the correct claim.
* Upload confirmation must be displayed.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to view and remove uploaded documents so that I can manage my claim attachments.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Customer can view uploaded documents.
* Customer can remove an attachment.
* Updated attachment list must be displayed.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want the portal to validate document type and size so that only supported files are uploaded.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Supported file types must be accepted.
* Unsupported file types must be rejected.
* Files exceeding the configured size limit must be rejected.
* Appropriate error messages must be displayed.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to view my current claim status so that I know the progress of my claim.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Customer can view their submitted claims.
* Current status must be displayed.
* Only authorized customers can view their own claims.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to view the claim status history so that I can understand previous updates.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Previous claim status updates must be displayed.
* Updates must be arranged chronologically.
* Relevant update dates must be displayed.

Summary: View Pending Actions and Missing Information
Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to view pending actions and missing information so that I can respond to insurer requests.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Pending actions must be displayed.
* Missing information must be identified.
* Customer must be able to understand what action is required.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to receive a claim submission confirmation so that I know my claim was received.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Confirmation must be generated after successful submission.
* Claim reference number must be included.
* Confirmation must be delivered through the configured notification channel.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to receive claim status notifications so that I stay informed about progress.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Notification must be triggered by relevant status updates.
* Updated claim status must be included.
* Notification must be sent through the configured channel.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to receive a settlement notification so that I know the outcome of my claim.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Customer must be notified of the settlement decision.
* Settlement details must be included where applicable.
* Notification must be sent through the configured channel.

Creator: Divyasree T
Description:
As a customer, I want to manage notification preferences so that I can choose how I receive updates.

*Acceptance Criteria:*

* Customer can view notification preferences.
* Customer can select available notification channels.
* Updated preferences must be saved.
